about: The keeper signers (build 17 K4): one key per signing unit, each pinned here by a reviewed commit. A unit may send only when its keystore (a Fly secret) derives exactly this public address; while an address is empty the unit runs dry runs only. The owner creates the keys with ops/make-keeper-secrets.sh and sends the printed public addresses to engineering. MON amounts: fund = the top-up target, minBalance = the warning floor (run-keeper.sh --min-balance), maxSpendPerDay = the daily cap (run-keeper.sh --max-spend-per-day); ops.test.mjs keeps them equal to run-keeper.sh.
